description_en: Query the status of a recording task
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-cloud-record-status --app-id 1qaz000x --channel-id testChannel --task-id taskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudRecordStatus

Status.description_en:
0: The task has started and is waiting for users to join.

100: The task has not started yet.

101: Recording in progress.

102: Uploading the recording file.

200: Recording completed because the channel ended.

201: Recording completed because the user stopped it.

400: Recording failed due to an internal server error.

401: Recording failed because writing to the user's storage failed.

402: Recording failed because starting the user's storage failed.

403: Recording failed because the recording duration was too short.

404: Recording failed because the user's storage key was invalid.

405: Recording failed because the bucket does not exist.

406: Recording failed because access to the user's storage was denied

406: 录制失败（访问用户存储被拒绝）
